+    def export_tasks_csv(
+        q: Optional[str] = Query(None),
+        status: Optional[str] = Query(None)
+    ):
+        conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path)
+        conn.create_function("qldapm_casefold", 1, lambda s: s.casefold() if s is not None else "")
+        cursor = conn.cursor()
+        query = "SELECT id, title, status FROM tasks WHERE 1=1"
+        params = []
+        
+        if q is not None:
+            query += " AND qldapm_casefold(title) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'"
+            escaped_q = q.casefold().replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('%', '\\%').replace('_', '\\_')
+            params.append(f"%{escaped_q}%")
+            
+        if status is not None:
+            if status not in ("todo", "in_progress", "done"):
+                conn.close()
+                raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Invalid status")
+            query += " AND status = ?"
+            params.append(status)
+            
+        query += " ORDER BY id ASC"
+        cursor.execute(query, params)
+        rows = cursor.fetchall()
+        conn.close()
+
+        output = io.StringIO()
+        writer = csv.writer(output)
+        writer.writerow(["id", "title", "status"])
+        for r in rows:
+            writer.writerow([r[0], r[1], r[2]])
+        csv_content = output.getvalue()
+        
+        return Response(
+            content=csv_content,
+            media_type="text/csv; charset=utf-8",
+            headers={"Content-Disposition": "attachment; filename=tasks.csv"}
+        )

+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from task_manager.app import create_app
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def client(tmp_path):
+    db_path = tmp_path / "test_csv.db"
+    app = create_app(str(db_path))
+    return TestClient(app)
+
+def test_export_csv_headers_and_empty(client):
+    response = client.get("/tasks/export.csv")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers["content-type"] == "text/csv; charset=utf-8"
+    assert response.headers["content-disposition"] == "attachment; filename=tasks.csv"
+    assert response.text == "id,title,status\r\n"
+
+def test_export_csv_data_and_sorting(client):
+    client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Beta Task"})
+    client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Alpha Task"})
+    
+    response = client.get("/tasks/export.csv")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    lines = response.text.strip().split("\r\n")
+    assert len(lines) == 3
+    assert lines[0] == "id,title,status"
+    assert lines[1].startswith("1,Beta Task,")
+    assert lines[2].startswith("2,Alpha Task,")
+
+def test_export_csv_unicode_and_special_chars(client):
+    client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "ĐI CHỢ, mua \"sữa\" \nvà bánh"})
+    response = client.get("/tasks/export.csv")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert "ĐI CHỢ, mua \"sữa\" \nvà bánh" in response.text or '"ĐI CHỢ, mua ""sữa"" \nvà bánh"' in response.text
+
+def test_export_csv_filters_and_invalid_status(client):
+    client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Apple Buy"})
+    t2 = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Banana Shop"}).json()["id"]
+    client.patch(f"/tasks/{t2}", json={"status": "in_progress"})
+
+    # Test q filter
+    res_q = client.get("/tasks/export.csv?q=apple")
+    assert res_q.status_code == 200
+    assert "Apple Buy" in res_q.text
+    assert "Banana Shop" not in res_q.text
+
+    # Test status filter
+    res_status = client.get("/tasks/export.csv?status=in_progress")
+    assert res_status.status_code == 200
+    assert "Banana Shop" in res_status.text
+    assert "Apple Buy" not in res_status.text
+
+    # Test invalid status -> 422
+    res_invalid = client.get("/tasks/export.csv?status=unknown")
+    assert res_invalid.status_code == 422
+
+def test_export_csv_route_precedence(client):
+    # Ensure /tasks/export.csv is not captured by /tasks/{task_id} (which would expect int and return 422 or 404)
+    response = client.get("/tasks/export.csv")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers["content-type"] == "text/csv; charset=utf-8"
